**Grant Application: Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant**

**Organization:** Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC)
**Request Amount:** $15,000

Sacramento's communities of color disproportionately bear the burden of gun-related incidents, demanding culturally competent safety education that resonates locally. Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) is a minority-owned social enterprise directly addressing this critical need, fostering gun safety awareness and responsible practices within these neighborhoods.

**Need & Programs:**
Our community along the Stockton Blvd corridor faces significant challenges related to firearm safety. GAFC employs innovative, accessible strategies to engage all ages. Our 'Gloxsie 21' cartoon IP educates children on gun safety in an age-appropriate, engaging format. We complement this with AI-powered educational modules for teens and adults, demystifying firearm mechanics and promoting responsible storage. Crucially, our community workshops, often hosted with our trusted partner, Church of Legacy, provide hands-on training and open dialogue directly within the neighborhoods we serve.

**Outcomes & Qualification:**
A Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant of $15,000 will enable GAFC to expand our proven programs, directly impacting hundreds of families along the corridor. We anticipate a measurable reduction in accidental firearm injuries, increased responsible gun storage practices, and a more informed populace better equipped to navigate firearm presence safely. As a minority-owned organization deeply embedded in these communities, GAFC brings authentic understanding and trust. Our unique approach, combined with the credibility of Church of Legacy, positions us as uniquely effective in building a safer, more informed Sacramento. We are the change agents our community needs.
